name: research_qa
description: Production-like golden dataset for multi-agent research pipeline evaluation

researcher.summary: Multi-agent AI involves multiple AI agents collaborating to solve complex tasks.

writer.report: Multi-agent AI systems use multiple agents that work together to solve complex tasks.

final_expected_output.report: Multi-agent AI systems use multiple agents that work together to solve complex tasks.

pipeline_input.query: Compare LangGraph vs CrewAI for building agent workflows

researcher.summary: LangGraph: state machine based, graph structure. CrewAI: role-based, task delegation.

writer.report: LangGraph uses state machines for graph-based workflows. CrewAI uses role-based task delegation.

final_expected_output.report: LangGraph uses state machines for graph-based workflows. CrewAI uses role-based task delegation. Both are suitable for multi-agent systems.

pipeline_input.query: What are the main failure modes in multi-agent systems?

researcher.summary: Error propagation, cascading failures, orchestration breakdown, inter-agent inconsistency.

writer.report: Key failure modes: error propagation between agents, cascading failures, orchestration breakdown, inter-agent inconsistency.

final_expected_output.report: Key failure modes in multi-agent systems include: error propagation between agents, cascading failures, orchestration breakdown, and inter-agent inconsistency.

pipeline_input.query: Summarize the benefits of agentic AI for enterprise software

researcher.summary: Automation, task decomposition, parallel execution, human-in-the-loop.

writer.report: Benefits: automation, task decomposition, parallel execution, human-in-the-loop workflows.

final_expected_output.report: Agentic AI benefits for enterprise: automation, task decomposition, parallel execution, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

pipeline_input.query: What is RAG and how does it relate to agent systems?

researcher.summary: RAG: Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Agents use RAG for grounding.

writer.report: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) grounds LLM outputs. Agents use RAG for retrieval and context.

final_expected_output.report: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) grounds LLM outputs with retrieved context. Agent systems use RAG for grounding and knowledge retrieval.

pipeline_input.query: Explain the difference between single-LLM and multi-agent evaluation

researcher.summary: Single-LLM: per-call metrics. Multi-agent: propagation, consistency, orchestration.

writer.report: Single-LLM eval focuses on per-call metrics. Multi-agent eval adds propagation, consistency, orchestration.

final_expected_output.report: Single-LLM evaluation focuses on per-call metrics. Multi-agent evaluation adds error propagation, inter-agent consistency, and orchestration adherence.

pipeline_input.query: What tools do agents typically use for web search?

researcher.summary: SerpAPI, Tavily, DuckDuckGo, custom search APIs.

writer.report: Common tools: SerpAPI, Tavily, DuckDuckGo, custom search APIs.

final_expected_output.report: Agents commonly use SerpAPI, Tavily, DuckDuckGo, and custom search APIs for web search.

pipeline_input.query: How do you handle agent failures and retries in production?

researcher.summary: Exponential backoff, fallbacks, circuit breakers, timeout handling.

writer.report: Strategies: exponential backoff, fallback agents, circuit breakers, timeout handling.

final_expected_output.report: Production strategies for agent failures: exponential backoff, fallback agents, circuit breakers, and timeout handling.

pipeline_input.query: What is chain-of-thought prompting and when is it useful?

researcher.summary: CoT: step-by-step reasoning. Useful for complex reasoning.

writer.report: Chain-of-thought: step-by-step reasoning. Useful for complex reasoning tasks.

final_expected_output.report: Chain-of-thought prompting elicits step-by-step reasoning. It is useful for complex reasoning and multi-step tasks.

pipeline_input.query: What are the main challenges in evaluating multi-agent systems?

writer.report: Challenges: error propagation, inter-agent consistency, orchestration, cost, latency.

final_expected_output.report: Main challenges: error propagation between agents, inter-agent consistency, orchestration adherence, cost tracking, and latency.
